guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：車用網路安全監測
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Vehicle-network security monitoring
guides.concept: 以車載訊息、被動觀測與安全責任串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect vehicle messages, passive observation and safety responsibility through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「車載功能圖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：動力、車身與資訊娛樂具不同風險與時限。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定訊框，只改時間間隔模式。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「訊息識別」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「匯流排負載」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：負載估計需含訊框與協議開銷。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定訊框，只改時間間隔模式。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「週期基線」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「跨信號關系」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：相關訊號可互證但不能假定永久線性。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較正常診斷與未批准診斷的合成事件。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「閘道邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「OTA 完整性」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：更新來源與版本驗證不同於下載成功。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留規則，只改匯流排負載。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「記錄與隱私」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「誤報處置」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：錯誤阻斷可能影響安全，回應須经設計審查。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬監測器失效對告警覆蓋的影響。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「安全責任」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「合成驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：本課只分析自製記錄，不連接或注入真實車輛。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬監測器失效對告警覆蓋的影響。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「車載功能圖」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around vehicle function maps, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Powertrain, body and infotainment have different risks/deadlines. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frames and vary interarrival patterns. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat message identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around bus load, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Load estimates include frames and protocol overhead. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frames and vary interarrival patterns. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat periodic baselines as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around cross-signal relations, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Related signals corroborate but need not be permanently linear. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare authorized/unauthorized synthetic diagnostic events. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat gateway boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around ota integrity, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Update origin/version verification differs from download success. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary bus load. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat logs and privacy as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around false-alert handling, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: False blocking can affect safety; review responses formally. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model monitor failure and alert-coverage effects. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat safety responsibilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around synthetic acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: This course analyzes authored records without connecting/injecting into vehicles. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model monitor failure and alert-coverage effects. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat vehicle function maps as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「管理系統」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「合成驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「合成驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for management systems. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for synthetic acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

pitfalls: 資安監測可取代全部功能安全驗證。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: Cybersecurity monitoring replaces all functional-safety validation. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
guides.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

courses.overview: 由車載訊息、被動觀測與安全責任連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect vehicle messages, passive observation and safety responsibility to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 工控網路分區與隔離
related.why: 可移植「車載功能圖」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from vehicle function maps; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「車載功能圖」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from vehicle function maps; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理車載訊息、被動觀測與安全責任；「工控網路分區與隔離」主要處理OT 區域、通道與不中斷的防禦證據，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes vehicle messages, passive observation and safety responsibility; Industrial-control network segmentation emphasizes ot zones, conduits and non-disruptive defensive evidence. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「車用網路安全監測」與「工控網路分區與隔離」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「週期基線」的對照方法至「流矩陣」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Vehicle-network security monitoring and Industrial-control network segmentation flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from periodic baselines to flow matrices, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
